packages.name: esp-idf
packages.summary: Espressif IoT Development Framework -- the official development framework for Espressif Systems' chips.
packages.comment:
# The cve-exclude-list list contains CVEs, which were already evaluated and the package is not vulnerable.
cve-exclude-list:
-   cve: CVE-2025-27840
    reason: A security issue was reported concerning undocumented HCI commands in
        ESP32 Bluetooth controller. Espressif had earlier clarified that these vendor
        HCI commands are primarily used for debugging purposes and pose no real, known
        security threat. Technical details were shared in this https://developer.espressif.com/blog/2025/03/esp32-bluetooth-clearing-the-air/

packages.name: freertos
packages.summary: An open-source, real-time operating system (RTOS) with additional features and patches from Espressif.
packages.comment:
# The cve-exclude-list list contains CVEs, which were already evaluated and the package is not vulnerable.
cve-exclude-list:
-   cve: CVE-2026-77234
    reason: A timer command submitted by an unprivileged task is executed by the timer
        service task as a caller-supplied function call. Affects only MPU-enabled
        ports (GHSA-w3vr-pr75-5hc6). ESP-IDF ships the xtensa, riscv and linux ports
        only, none of which set portUSING_MPU_WRAPPERS, so the MPU wrappers and the
        privilege boundary they enforce are not built. Same reasoning as CVE-2024-28115,
        already excluded in the FreeRTOS-Kernel manifest.
-   cve: CVE-2026-77237
    reason: Missing queue-set type validation in xQueueAddToSet() leading to an out-of-bounds
        read in privileged kernel context. Affects only MPU-enabled ports with configUSE_QUEUE_SETS=1
        (GHSA-9wvc-hqvx-5wf5). ESP-IDF ships the xtensa, riscv and linux ports only,
        none of which set portUSING_MPU_WRAPPERS, so there is no privileged/unprivileged
        split for the over-read to cross.
-   cve: CVE-2026-77235
    reason: Missing privilege verification in the secure context cleanup SVC handler,
        letting a Non-Secure task free another task's secure context (GHSA-55pf-q87x-c58c).
        Affects ARMv8-M ports with TrustZone and MPU only. ESP-IDF ships the xtensa,
        riscv and linux ports only and carries no secure_context sources, so the affected
        code is not present.
-   cve: CVE-2026-77236
    reason: Missing minimum size validation in secure context allocation, writing
        the stack-overflow sentinel outside the allocated Secure-world buffer (GHSA-vq2f-9qj3-jj2m).
        Affects ARMv8-M ports with TrustZone only. ESP-IDF ships the xtensa, riscv
        and linux ports only and carries no secure_context sources, so the affected
        code is not present.
-   cve: CVE-2024-28115
    reason: Affects only ARMv7-M MPU ports, and ARMv8-M ports with Memory Protected
        Unit (MPU) support enabled

packages.name: lwip
packages.summary: A Lightweight TCP/IP stack with additional features and patches from Espressif.
packages.originator: Organization: non-GNU software and documentation, lwIP Project <lwip-members@nongnu.org>
packages.comment:
# The cve-exclude-list list contains CVEs, which were already evaluated and the package is not vulnerable.
cve-exclude-list:
-   cve: CVE-2020-22283
    reason: 'ICMPv6 out-of-bounds read (savannah #58553) in icmp6_send_response_with_addrs_and_netif().
        Fixed upstream by commits 489405839ae0 and 488d4ad2460c (lwIP 2.1.3/2.2.0),
        further hardened by 2bf8fcd7c240; all present as ancestors in the vendored
        esp-lwip fork. NVD''s CPE has no fixed-version boundary ("git head"), causing
        the version match.'

packages.name: newlib
packages.summary: Newlib is a small C standard library for embedded systems
packages.comment:
# The cve-exclude-list list contains CVEs, which were already evaluated and the package is not vulnerable.
cve-exclude-list:
-   cve: CVE-2024-30949
    reason: A vulnerability was discovered in the gettimeofday system call implementation
        within the RISC-V libgloss component of Newlib. ESP-IDF does not link against
        libgloss for RISC-V, hence the issue is not directly applicable. Still, the
        relevant fix has been patched through https://github.com/espressif/newlib-esp32/commit/047ba47013c2656a1e7838dc86cbc75aeeaa67a7
